## 更新内容

- 修复 0.5.4 中更多 ChatGPT 布局仍触发“不支持的 HTML 内容”的问题，新增文字对齐、宽高、说明文字和链接组件支持。
- SVG 图示（包括带模板循环的图示）以明确标注的源码块保留，暂不渲染为图片，不再阻断整段对话保存。
- 保留正文、代码示例、图片校验、引用处理及提交前 API 复查。未知 HTML 仍会明确报错。

下载 **`ai-inbox-browser-0.5.5.zip`**，将解压后的文件覆盖到原扩展目录，在 Chrome / Edge 扩展管理页点击“重新加载”，再刷新聊天页面。首次安装请启用开发者模式，加载包含 `manifest.json` 的 `ai-inbox-browser` 目录。

ChatGPT 兼容 Obsidian 插件 0.3.0+；Gemini / Claude 需要 0.5.0+。建议通过 BRAT 更新到 [Obsidian 插件 0.5.2](https://github.com/elfmedy/obsidian-ai-inbox/releases/tag/0.5.2)。保留原目录与配对，无需删除笔记。

## What's new

- Fix additional unsupported-HTML failures remaining in 0.5.4, covering ChatGPT text-alignment and sizing attributes, captions and literal link components.
- Retain SVG diagrams, including template loops, as clearly labelled source blocks rather than rendered images. These diagrams no longer block saving the conversation.
- Preserve surrounding text, code examples, image checks, citation handling and the final API recheck. Unknown HTML still reports an explicit error.

Download **`ai-inbox-browser-0.5.5.zip`**, replace files in the existing extension folder, click Reload in Chrome / Edge, and refresh the chat. For a first installation, enable Developer mode and load the `ai-inbox-browser` folder containing `manifest.json`.

Requires Obsidian plugin 0.3.0+ for ChatGPT, or 0.5.0+ for Gemini / Claude. Updating through BRAT to [Obsidian plugin 0.5.2](https://github.com/elfmedy/obsidian-ai-inbox/releases/tag/0.5.2) is recommended. Keep existing notes and pairing.

Alpha · Chrome 120+ / Chromium-based Microsoft Edge · Obsidian desktop required.
